def assess_website(target_input):
    """

    Audits:
      1. HTTP Security Headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
      2. SSL/TLS Certificate & Transport Security
      3. Server & Technology Fingerprinting
      4. Cookie Flags & Information Disclosure
      5. AI-driven Security Posture Grading (A+ to F) & Findings
    """
    target = target_input.strip()
    if not target.startswith("http://") and not target.startswith("https://"):
        target_url = "https://" + target
    else:
        target_url = target

    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(target_url)
    hostname = parsed.hostname or target
    port = parsed.port or (443 if parsed.scheme == "https" else 80)

    results = {
        "target": target_input,
        "normalized_url": target_url,
        "hostname": hostname,
        "assessment_time": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "resolved_ip": "Unknown",
        "ssl_telemetry": {},
        "headers_telemetry": {},
        "server_fingerprint": {},
        "findings": [],
        "score": 100,
        "grade": "A+",
        "summary": {}
    }

    # 1. DNS Resolution & IP Discovery
    try:
        ip_addr = socket.gethostbyname(hostname)

"# AEGIS-AI Enterprise Security Operations Platform (Walkthrough)

## Overview

The **AEGIS-AI** platform has been upgraded from a basic static report into an **enterprise-grade, motion-rich Security Operations Center (SOC) web application**. It implements **Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM)** and **Risk-Based Vulnerability Management (RBVM)** with contextual AI triage.

---

## What Was Built & Upgraded

### 1. Universal Online Website & System Assessor (`scanner_online.py` + `/api/scan-online`)
You can now audit **any website or domain on the internet** (e.g. `owasp.org`, `github.com`, `example.com`, or any company/college portal) in addition to your local Juice Shop container:
* **HTTP Security Headers Compliance:** Checks HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
* **SSL/TLS & Cryptographic Telemetry:** Handshakes with target port 443, reports TLS protocol version (e.g., TLSv1.3), cipher suite (`TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384`), issuer, and certificate status.
